content.bridge_context: We deepen our understanding of numbers by exploring Factors and Multiples, which are the building blocks of multiplication and division.

units.title: Factors
units.explanation: A factor is a number that divides another number exactly, without leaving a remainder.
units.dual_language_instruction: Find all divisors. / सभी विभाजकों को खोजें।

units.title: Multiples
units.explanation: Multiples are numbers we get by multiplying a number by other whole numbers (like 1, 2, 3...).
